mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high employment (PAYEMS > 155000) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.6) indicate a tight labor market, boosting corporate earnings and consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 155000 and UNRATE < 3.6 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1400 and GDPC1 > 20000), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to overvaluation and rising interest rates, producing negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1400 and GDPC1 > 20000 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply chain activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 300 (CPIAUCSL > 300) indicates elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 300 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to ease monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).
